home.text: Select your preferred breed or tell us what you're looking for. We'll guide you based on availability and your lifestyle.
home.title: Choose your breed

home.text: Our team will share real photos, health details, and all necessary information directly on WhatsApp.
home.title: Get photos & details

home.text: Once confirmed, we handle everything professionally and ensure your puppy reaches you safely and stress-free.
home.title: Secure & safe delivery

howItWorks.text: Browse our selection of available breeds and place a reservation for the teacup puppy that captures your heart. Our reservation-only model ensures that each puppy is specifically sourced to meet your preferences.
howItWorks.title: Reserve your puppy

howItWorks.text: Once your reservation is confirmed, we will work closely with you to finalize details and provide updates on your puppy's journey.
howItWorks.title: Personalized consultation

howItWorks.text: We manage all aspects of the import process, including health checks, travel arrangements, and necessary documentation. Your puppy will be carefully transported and will arrive ready to join your family.
howItWorks.title: Import and arrival

howItWorks.text: Upon arrival, we provide support to help your new puppy acclimate to their new environment. Our team is available for any additional assistance and to ensure a smooth transition into your home.
howItWorks.title: Welcome home
